name: CK Asset Holdings Limited
summary: CK Asset Holdings Limited is a global property developer headquartered in Central, Hong Kong, set up in 2015 and previously called Cheung Kong Property Holdings Limited until September 2017. Its markets stretch from Hong Kong and the mainland to Singapore, Britain, continental Europe, Australia, Canada and the United States. It leases offices, factories and shops, builds and invests in homes, runs pubs, hotels and serviced suites, and also does aircraft leasing, infrastructure investment, financial services and property agency work.
